messages:
olivia: quick question about validator placement: should the policy validator live in the compiler (preflight) or as an admission step in the control plane? thinking about latency of rollouts vs safety.

marcos: compiler-level is great for static checks and fast CI feedback. admission step catches runtime incompatibilities (e.g., model variant not deployed in region yet). we probably need both.

vishal: +1. compiler catches shape and obvious semantic issues. admission should run a subset of checks that are cheap and deterministic. heavy simulation -> async job.

olivia: ok. proposed split: 1) lint/semantic checks in PR CI (blocking) 2) dry-sim job in CI (async) that computes a small "risk" score 3) admission gate that enforces hard compatibility (kv-cache semantics, required hw features) and emits a short reason tag for telemetry.

jen: ops note: admission gate must be bounded in time (<200ms) and fail-open option available for emergencies. also require that audit log line is compact.

infra-bot: deploybot: queued dry-sim for pr-5234 commit d4c2. logs: https://ci.internal/pr-5234/logs

marcos: about the risk score - keep it deterministic and reproducible. use sampled traces seeded by request hash + policy version so different runs compare. risk score should be a float 0..1.

vishal: telemetry format suggestion (pipe-delimited for easier grep):
```
ts|req|tenant_hash|route|variant|reason_tag|lat_ms|cost_units|risk
2026-03-22T21:10:11Z|r-1b2c|sha256:abcd...|/chat|m-v2|FALLBACK_REGION|34|0.08|0.62
```
Keep tenant hashed by default; allow opt-in cleartext for debugging via support ticket.

olivia: we also need sampling controls per-tenant (0..100%) exposed in console + API. default to 1% for free tier, 10% for enterprise.

jen: add backpressure plan: if ingestion spikes, drop low-risk lines (risk < 0.2) after applying customer sample. record dropped_count per-bucket and emit periodic summaries to ops.

marcos: runtime hint field idea: include `validation_tag` in request decision metadata returned to user when requested by tenant. small stable tokens only. e.g., `kv_mismatch`, `region_degrade`, `cost_gate`.

vishal: validation_tag should be opt-out default to avoid changing payloads. also ensure SDKs ignore unknown tags. backward compat is critical.

olivia: action items: olivia -> RFC sketch for split-validator (due Fri) ; marcos -> deterministic risk scoring pseudo-spec + seed approach (due Wed) ; vishal -> telemetry ingestion proto + drop rules (due Thu) ; jen -> console sampling UI + retention draft (30d hot, 400d cold) (due Wed).

jen: ops will also add a small runbook: how to temporarily disable admission gate and how to rehydrate dropped telemetry for a customer investigation.

marcos: follow-up: run a 0.5% production replay in sandbox for a week once dry-sim is implemented. want to catch odd fail-open behaviors.

olivia: sounds good. if nobody objects I'll open the draft RFC and ticket the CI jobs tomorrow.

vishal: no objections. thanks! :thumbsup:
